ownership_rule: The project owns this database; no application owns it or its tables. The script of a project reaches it only through the one intermediary of the project database (qnc.module.db-broker), whose table module qnc.module.script-db owns it.

rules.order: The blocks are read in the order of position, 0, 1, 2...; a block is added after a chosen one or at the end, moves one place up or down, and leaves without a gap.
rules.off: An OFF block is the text the journalist writes and records; it is never empty. Its length comes from its words and the project's audio.reading_words_per_second.
rules.sot: A statement is a clip's frames [from_frame, to_frame) with its timecodes, length and seconds as shown when it was added, and the words said there (which may be corrected); it needs a clip and an IN before its OUT.
